title: Endpoint retrieval
description: Retrieval limits of the search tools of this endpoint. A key that is not set takes the application-wide default of the endpoint policy.

maxK.title: Maximum results
maxK.description: Upper bound of the result count a search may ask for; a larger `k` is clamped to it. Default: the policy's `defaultMaxK()`.

hybrid.title: Hybrid retrieval
hybrid.description: Combine vector and keyword search. Default: the policy's `defaultHybrid()`.

hybridWeight.title: Hybrid weight
hybridWeight.description: Weight of the keyword part in hybrid retrieval, 0 to 1. Default: the policy's `defaultHybridWeight()`.
